author: NovaLikesPvP
body:
Well, first, I know that I wouldn´t use this subject for player appeals, I would use support@avicus.net but the last time I used that you reply me 4 days after.

Well, Today I was playing Avicus, On Mczone01 and "Farming" On the map Quintus, when I went disconnected from the server and a message said " Banned / Hacking - Kill Aura".

Well, first, I wasn´t hacking, I was only " Farming " and killing like an idiot on Quintus, i don´t know what sunrise728 "saw" or "think" on that moment, but I wasn´t even hacking.

Thanks for seeing this "appeal", I repeat that i know that this isn´t a place for making player appeals, so, I will make it obviusly on support@avicus.net.

Hoping and praying for this been taken soon, Thank You.

Regards

NovaLikesPvP
